description: PWA Manifest + Service Worker + Organigramme page with manager_id hierarchy
steps: Create `public/` directory and `public/manifest.json` with name 'WorkDays', short_name 'WorkDays', start_url '/', display 'standalone', theme_color '#1e40af', background_color '#ffffff', icons 192x192 and 512x512 (use SVG inline data-uri or simple generated PNG placeholder)
Create `public/icon-192x192.svg` and `public/icon-512x512.svg` as simple SVG icons (blue calendar icon matching the app branding)
Create `public/sw.js` - basic service worker that caches the app shell for offline fallback

Update `src/app/layout.tsx`: add <link rel='manifest' href='/manifest.json'>, meta tags for theme-color, apple-mobile-web-app-capable, apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style, and a <script> block to register the service worker
Create migration `supabase/migrations/024-manager-id.sql`: ALTER TABLE employees ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS manager_id INTEGER REFERENCES employees(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;

Update `src/app/employees/[id]/edit/page.tsx`: add manager_id to the EmployeeForm interface, add it to emptyForm, fetch all employees (excluding current) for dropdown, add 'Responsable hierarchique' select in the Emploi section, include manager_id in the save payload

Create `src/app/employees/organigramme/page.tsx`: tree view page showing employee hierarchy. Root = employees with no manager_id. Children = employees whose manager_id points to parent. Each node shows name, job_title, sector. Click navigates to employee detail page. Use indented cards with CSS connection lines.
Update `src/app/employees/page.tsx`: add an 'Organigramme' link/button next to the 'Ajouter' button in the header area
acceptance_criteria: public/manifest.json exists with correct PWA configuration
public/sw.js exists and provides basic offline caching
Layout includes manifest link and PWA meta tags and SW registration script
Migration 024 adds manager_id column to employees table
Employee edit form has a 'Responsable hierarchique' dropdown that lists other employees
Page /employees/organigramme renders a tree view from employee data
Employees page has an 'Organigramme' navigation link
npx next build succeeds without errors
